title: Record that every even length from 4 through 18 meets the positive length-22 splits
body:
## Summary
- A one-bit prefix step flips weight parity, so every return has even length.
- For each of the ten positive length-22 splits, explicit restored words realize every return length from 4 through 18.
- Partial, no new kappa. The witnesses are not a word census and do not claim f(7).

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/even-return-lengths/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/even-return-lengths/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/even-return-lengths`
